about: The day stretches (H4 item 10, gate N18): free day play between a night's cinematic and the next place, in a permanent zone that resets by data/content/zone_resets.json. Read by logic/Play/Zones/DayStretch.cs: the zone (Prologue for lowford) places and runs it, the balance harness (godot/balance, lowford-day) plays the same fights. Beats in the order a sensible player takes them (DayStretch.Goal, the autopilot's and the harness's route: each pack's ground, a chest once its keepers are down, the post, the ring, the gate; along GroundPath round the trees): the road's boars, the Kerchiefs' camp 44 m east (its strongbox at its back), the road lamp, the boars' wallow 42 m west, the wolf ring at the gate. Every pack's waking ring stands 20 m or more clear of the next one's (DayStretchTests). pack: foes resting round (x, z) within spread, waking within wake m of her (Verge's packs), leashed to leash m; tell: the kit kind (data/content/telegraphs.json) its foes cast, first firstAfter s after waking, then every [min, max] s, from within the kind's reach; captain: one more of that kind, a champion (elite: three times the life), who leads (a kerchief_captain rallies and calls more out of the trees).  post: a Lamps v2 lamp-post (lamps_v2.json) on the zone's light, relit by an interact within r. chest: a strongbox. ring: the Flare's save, a closing (Battle.TellClosing) of n of def round her once she comes north past z after being south of armZ; her Flare filled to flareTo of full if short; then the rest of the pack (follow: n of def, and one of elite as a champion) comes out of the trees between her and the gate followAfter s later. Foe level: 1 + (her level + day) / 2 + levelUp (the Verge's). Coordinates read off data/zones/lowford/zone.json (paths.ROAD; the road lamps are lights 13 (2,-64) and 14 (-1,-86); the gate at z -112, exitZ -104). C04 A hands back at its 'up' mark (0.45, -63). tellBy: only that kind casts the pack's tell (the wallow's sows do not charge). ring: halfWidth, it springs only within that of its x (a fight at a camp that strays north does not spring it). waves (a pack's): its next wave out of the trees round its ground (out m from it) once under or fewer of it stand, elite one more of that kind as a champion (the camp's sleepers out of the tents, the wallow's from the reeds).
